summary: The app is on `desk:apps:temp` (20 lines), and I checked it by hand: typing `25.5` shows `F: 77.9`, `2` shows `F: 35.6`, `-40` shows `F: -40`, letters are ignored, and Backspace works down to empty.

files.desk:apps:temp:
app 'Thermometer'
task start()
  give {t: ''}
done
task key(s, k)
  when count(k) is 1 and '0123456789-.' has k
    set s.t to edit_text(s.t, k)
  or when k is 'backspace'
    set s.t to edit_text(s.t, k)
  done
  give s
done
task draw(s)
  show(1, 1, 'C: ' & s.t)
  when is_number(s.t)
    show(2, 1, 'F: ' & text(number(s.t) * 9 / 5 + 32))
  otherwise
    show(2, 1, 'F: ?')
  done
done
